[engine] A gate must first be shown to REJECT something. If the reference artifact was produced by the configuration under test, the self-comparison only proves non-determinism, never correctness.

## 為什麼（because）

The bit-identical reference was itself a cache-ON product, so 19/19 could only demonstrate determinism and pool-size invariance. m123_oracle_gate.py now refuses cache-ON .cap files as ground truth (--oracle-abs), and the two selftests exist to prove the gate turns red.
